mail.notes: Fresh Edge1 evidence continues to cover mail.status.read and mail.draft.prepare with prepared-not-sent/no-send semantics only. Phase 28 adds a repository-functional local-native correspondence path: bounded local RFC822 intake, private SQLite bodies/threads with immutable source+scope provenance, authenticated loopback Mail API reads, and a least-privileged BigBird Mail facade. Synthetic records cannot be upgraded to readable authority; local-native records remain explicitly production_provider_ready=false. Phase 28 does not claim Edge1 deployment of correspondence reads, production-native provider readiness, or BigBird live registration. Registering wwcx-private-ai with the deployed HMAC API is an authentication-policy change and remains separately controlled. Production mail routing/send remains blocked.

MMS security remains degraded until that runtime evidence exists. Quarantine release and live carrier traffic remain blocked.
